abasin.notes: We are open for the 2026/27 Season!As A-Basin celebrates its 80th anniversary this winter, the ski area will mark the occasionwith a season-long celebration of the people and culture that have shaped The Legend forgenerations. While much has changed over eight decades, the spirit of A-Basin remains thesame.All season long, join us in celebrating nearly a century of fantastic skiing and riding withevents, deals, giveaways, and more.80-Year-Olds Ski Free – You’ve been with us this whole time. So, in celebration of A-Basin'slegacy and yours, anyone who is 80 years old can ski free every Wednesday

Windmill and Klondike give you two top-to-bottom runs, plus the Woodward terrain park. It's 34 degrees with mostly sunny skies forecasted and a high near 38. steamboat.notes: Good Morning, Skiers and Riders! This is Laurie with your snow report from 5am for Friday, November 27. Welcome to winter 26/27 Opening Day! Come early for free Powder Day Donuts and mimosa while supplies last. Our Mid mountain base is 2 inches, the temperature is 31 degrees, the winds are 8 miles per hour from the NNW, with cloudy skies. The Summit base is 7 inches, the temperature is 25 degrees, the winds are 5 miles per hour from the WNW, with cloudy skies. The base temperature is 27 degrees. We will be skiing and riding on 6 lifts, 2 runs, and 38 acres on MM snow. Be sure to stop by Rendez

aspenmtn.notes: We are grateful for skiing, snowboarding and you! Thanks to everyone who came out Thursday to celebrate the 80th time Aspen Mountain opened for the season! Winter is officially underway. Start the season with fresh turns, open runs, and the stoke of getting back on the mountain. Keep the celebrations going this Saturday with opening parties at the Sundeck and Elk Camp. With snow in the forecast, the season is off to a promising start. Here's to 80 years of mountain memories and many more to come. Safety tip of the day: Always stay in control. You must be able to stop or avoid people or objects
